Standard exercism bottle-song. Implement recite using the number-to-word mapping.

_NUMBERS = {
    0: "no",
    1: "One",
    2: "Two",
    3: "Three",
    4: "Four",
    5: "Five",
    6: "Six",
    7: "Seven",
    8: "Eight",
    9: "Nine",
    10: "Ten",
}


def _bottles(count):
    return "bottle" if count == 1 else "bottles"


def _verse(n):
    return [
        f"{_NUMBERS[n]} green {_bottles(n)} hanging on the wall,",
        f"{_NUMBERS[n]} green {_bottles(n)} hanging on the wall,",
        "And if one green bottle should accidentally fall,",
        f"There'll be {_NUMBERS[n - 1].lower()} green {_bottles(n - 1)} hanging on the wall.",
    ]


def recite(start, take=1):
    lines = []
    for i in range(take):
        if i > 0:
            lines.append("")
        lines.extend(_verse(start - i))
    return lines
